name: Elmnts Chevron-operated mineral rights fund (public marketing description)
description_text: Manual entry based solely on public press / marketing descriptions of Elmnts' first tokenized mineral-rights fund on Solana (Chevron-operated land royalties), offered as a Reg D 506(c) security to accredited investors. This is NOT a live API pull — no public unauthenticated Elmnts production/payout endpoint was found (see adapters/FINDINGS.md).
yield_calculation_basis: Press coverage describes 'double-digit' or 'north of 20%' target yields, but those phrases are marketing ranges, not a single numeric advertised_yield_pct published as a stable figure for this tranche, and no realized distribution history is publicly readable without investor login. Both yield fields left null rather than inventing a number.
protocol_age_months_unknown_reason: Elmnts public launch timing is described in press (beta ~Oct 2024) but a precise protocol-age month count was not confirmed from a primary Elmnts public data source during this manual entry.
asset_age_months_unknown_reason: Specific tranche open date for the Chevron-land fund is not published on a reachable public endpoint.
completed_payout_cycles_unknown_reason: No public payout history API; distribution records require investor-platform access which was not used.
estimated_time_to_exit_days_unknown_reas: No public secondary-market or redemption timeline published in the marketing materials used for this entry.
underlying_reference: Tokenized mineral-rights fund tranche described in public press as Chevron-operated land royalties (Elmnts first offering)
operator_track_record_notes: Operator identity taken from public press describing Elmnts' first fund; this manual entry does not verify operator affiliation on-chain or via Elmnts' investor portal.
